label: Milashan yak

about.text: The Milashan is a Chinese yak population that is milked. A 2023 review of yak milk lists it as having the highest milk solids of the Chinese breeds it compares, at about 19.0 percent, with fat at about 7.4 percent.

links.name: Yak Milk: Nutritional Value, Functional Activity, and Current Applications (Foods, 2023)

sources.text: Table 1 of the review, which gives per-breed composition for Chinese milked yak populations. The review does not describe the Milashan's range or husbandry in the parts read.
